title: SSC CHSL Exam Guide: 10+2 Central Govt Jobs, Syllabus & Typing Strategy
summary: Everything you need to crack the SSC Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) exam for Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Data Entry Operator (DEO), and JSA posts.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction The Staff Selection Commission Combined Higher Secondary Level (SSC CHSL) examination is one of the most widely attempted examinations in India for 12th-pass aspirants. It serves as the direct pipeline for recruitment into ministries, subordinate departments, and constitutional offices for prestigious roles such as Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO). ## Eligibility Criteria | Parameter | Requirements | |---|---| | **Educational Qualification** | Must have passed 12th Standard or equivalent examination from a recognized Board or University. For DEO in CAG/Ministry departments, 12th pass in Science stream with Mathematics is mandatory. | | **Nationality** | A citizen of India, subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or person of Indian origin migrated permanently. | | **Computer & Typing Skill** | Typing speed of 35 w.p.m. (English) or 30 w.p.m. (Hindi) for LDC/JSA; 8,000 to 15,000 key depressions per hour for DEO. | | **Physical Fitness** | Standard fitness without debilitating chronic conditions. Specific physical efficiency requirements apply to Border Roads Organisation (BRO) posts. | ## Age Limit & Relaxations | Category | Age Range | Upper Age Relaxation | |---|---|---| | **General / EWS** | 18 - 27 Years | Nil (0 Years) | | **OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)** | 18 - 27 Years | 3 Years (Up to 30 Years) | | **SC / ST** | 18 - 27 Years | 5 Years (Up to 32 Years) | | **PwBD (Unreserved)** | 18 - 27 Years | 10 Years (Up to 37 Years) | | **PwBD (OBC)** | 18 - 27 Years | 13 Years (Up to 40 Years) | | **PwBD (SC/ST)** | 18 - 27 Years | 15 Years (Up to 42 Years) | | **Ex-Servicemen (ESM)** | 18 - 27 Years | 3 years after deduction of military service | ## Examination Structure & Pattern ### Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective Type) | Subject | Number of Questions | Maximum Marks | Time Duration | |---|---|---|---| | **English Language (Basic Knowledge)** | 25 Questions | 50 Marks | Combined 60 Minutes | | **General Intelligence & Reasoning** | 25 Questions | 50 Marks | (80 minutes for scribe candidates) | | **Quantitative Aptitude (Basic Arithmetic)** | 25 Questions | 50 Marks | Negative marking: 0.50 marks per wrong answer | | **General Awareness (Static GK & Current Affairs)** | 25 Questions | 50 Marks | | | **Total** | **100 Questions** | **200 Marks** | **60 Minutes (Qualifying for Tier-2)** | ### Tier-2: Computer Based Exam & Skill/Typing Test | Session | Section / Module | Questions | Marks | Duration | |---|---|---|---|---| | **Section I** | Module-I: Mathematical Abilities
Module-II: Reasoning & General Intelligence | 30 Questions
30 Questions (60 total) | 180 Marks (3 marks each) | 1 Hour | | **Section II** | Module-I: English Language & Comprehension
Module-II: General Awareness | 40 Questions
20 Questions (60 total) | 180 Marks (3 marks each) | 1 Hour | | **Section III** | Computer Knowledge Module | 15 Questions | 45 Marks | 15 Minutes (Qualifying) | | **Session II** | Skill Test / Typing Test Module | Passage Typing Test | Qualifying | 10 - 15 Minutes | ## Important Official Links | Link Title | Action / Destination URL | |---|---| | **Official Website** | [https://ssc.gov.in](https://ssc.gov.in) | | **Official Notification Portal** | [Download Notification](https://ssc.gov.in/for-candidates/tentative-vacancy) | | **Apply Online Portal** | [Click Here to Apply](https://ssc.gov.in/apply) | | **Admit Card Download** | [Get Admit Card](https://ssc.gov.in/admit-card) | | **Typing Practice Guidelines** | [Download Syllabus](https://ssc.gov.in/candidate-corner/syllabus) | | **Check Final Result** | [View Result Dashboard](https://ssc.gov.in/results) | ## Comprehensive Preparation Strategy | Phase | Target Goals & Daily Regimen | |---|---| | **Phase 1: Arithmetic & Grammar Mastery** | Revise NCERT Mathematics up to Class 10 (Percentages, Ratio, Algebra, Trigonometry, Geometry). Master English rules from standard grammar guides and learn 15 new idioms & one-word substitutions daily. | | **Phase 2: Reasoning & Current Affairs** | Practice non-verbal reasoning, coding-decoding, number series, and syllogisms. Read 6 months of monthly current affairs digests covering awards, sports, and cabinet appointments. | | **Phase 3: Computer Knowledge Preparation** | Prepare basic computer architecture, MS Word, MS Excel shortcut keys, internet protocols, and cybersecurity terms to clear the mandatory Tier-2 computer cutoff. | | **Phase 4: Daily Typing & Mock Drills** | Practice typing for 30 minutes daily on standard software using all 10 fingers. Strive for 40 w.p.m. with 95%+ accuracy to breeze through the final skill test. | SSC CHSL rewards applicants who balance high-speed arithmetic with consistent keyboard typing practice. Start typing early alongside your written studies to ensure complete confidence on exam day.
